search.description: search services to use, in order: a list or comma-separated names (tinyfish, anysearch, tavily, exa, firecrawl, jina); default: every service with an API key. Keys are read from the environment and $JADE_HOME/.env (/search sets them). $JADE_SEARCH still works

results.description: results per web_search, 1-20, default 10; $JADE_SEARCH_RESULTS still works
